# 01.2 Your First HTML Page

Time to build a complete page from scratch: a simple "About Me" page with a valid document structure and a little content about yourself.

**Your task:** complete `index.html` so it is a well-formed HTML5 document.

- Include a full skeleton: the `<!DOCTYPE html>` declaration and properly nested `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>` tags.
- Put a `<title>` of `About Me` inside the `<head>`.
- Add one `<h1>` heading reading `About Me` in the `<body>`.
- Add at least two `<p>` paragraphs describing yourself or your interest in web development.
- Make sure every tag is correctly opened and closed.

**Expected result:** opening the file in a browser shows the "About Me" heading followed by your paragraphs, the tab reads "About Me", and inspecting the page in developer tools reveals a clean, properly nested element tree.
